about: Packages whose own files carry other packages that esbuild's metafile never shows: for each carrier (name@version), those it carries. fromNodeModules: their license texts come from their own folders in node_modules (which the lockfile must have); withATextOfOurs: a package that is not in node_modules, with its text in licenses/. build.mjs reads the source maps of the carriers' files and fails when they carry a package not listed here. Read the carriers' dist again after an upgrade (UPGRADING.md). textsOfOurs: packages in the bundle that ship no license file (by name, or a scope as "@radix-ui/*"), with the license text of their repository in licenses/.

fonteditor-core.note: built into Excalidraw's font subsetter as WebAssembly

harfbuzzjs.note: built into Excalidraw's font subsetter as WebAssembly; its text says which of its parts are under Apache-2.0
